flashcards.example_vi: Chắc chắn là chiếc máy tính bảng của em – em không sống thiếu nó được!

flashcards.back_en: A machine or tool made to do a particular job.
flashcards.example_en: A tablet is a device you can use to go online and message your friends.
flashcards.example_vi: Máy tính bảng là thiết bị em có thể dùng để vào mạng và nhắn tin cho bạn bè.

flashcards.back_en: Something good about a thing; a reason it helps you.
flashcards.example_en: Name two advantages and one disadvantage of each gadget.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy nêu hai ưu điểm và một nhược điểm của mỗi món đồ.

flashcards.back_en: Something bad about a thing; a problem with it.
flashcards.example_en: One disadvantage of a mountain bike is that you can't use it in the rain.
flashcards.example_vi: Một nhược điểm của xe đạp địa hình là em không dùng được khi trời mưa.

flashcards.back_en: To have a particular heaviness.
flashcards.example_en: In 1973 this gadget was 22 centimetres long and weighed 1.13 kilograms.
flashcards.example_vi: Năm 1973, món đồ này dài 22 xăng-ti-mét và nặng 1,13 ki-lô-gam.

flashcards.back_en: Like a human.
flashcards.example_en: Asimo is the most advanced humanoid robot in the world.
flashcards.example_vi: Asimo là robot hình người tiên tiến nhất thế giới.

flashcards.back_en: A device that detects objects nearby.
flashcards.example_en: Asimo moves by itself using sensors inside its body.
flashcards.example_vi: Asimo tự di chuyển nhờ các cảm biến bên trong cơ thể.

flashcards.back_en: A device that produces electricity.
flashcards.example_en: Asimo is just over one metre tall and has a rechargeable battery.
flashcards.example_vi: Asimo cao hơn một mét một chút và có pin sạc lại được.

flashcards.back_en: To change something to make it better.
flashcards.example_en: Scientists have upgraded Asimo's technology, so it has more skills.
flashcards.example_vi: Các nhà khoa học đã nâng cấp công nghệ của Asimo nên nó có thêm nhiều kỹ năng.

flashcards.back_en: An order telling a person or machine what to do.
flashcards.example_en: It can understand voice commands and human gestures.
flashcards.example_vi: Nó hiểu được khẩu lệnh và cử chỉ của con người.

flashcards.back_en: A movement of the hands or head that means something.
flashcards.example_en: Asimo recognises human gestures as well as moving objects.
flashcards.example_vi: Asimo nhận ra cử chỉ của con người và cả những vật đang chuyển động.

flashcards.back_en: Something completely new that somebody has made.
flashcards.example_en: Kim gave a presentation about her idea for a new invention.
flashcards.example_vi: Kim thuyết trình về ý tưởng cho một phát minh mới.

flashcards.back_en: The people who listen to or watch you.
flashcards.example_en: Think about who your audience is before you plan your presentation.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy nghĩ xem người nghe của em là ai trước khi lên kế hoạch thuyết trình.

flashcards.back_en: A person who decides who wins a competition.
flashcards.example_en: Which idea will the judges choose?
flashcards.example_vi: Ban giám khảo sẽ chọn ý tưởng nào?

flashcards.back_en: To find an answer to a problem.
flashcards.example_en: Uber Jet Boots will solve the traffic problems in our city.
flashcards.example_vi: Giày phản lực Uber sẽ giải quyết vấn đề giao thông ở thành phố chúng ta.

flashcards.back_en: A short repeat of the main points at the end.
flashcards.example_en: A summary of the idea comes at the end of the presentation.
flashcards.example_vi: Phần tóm tắt ý tưởng nằm ở cuối bài thuyết trình.

flashcards.back_en: Having a lot of force or strength.
flashcards.example_en: The jet will be so powerful that you can stand up straight.
flashcards.example_vi: Luồng phản lực sẽ mạnh đến mức em có thể đứng thẳng người.

flashcards.back_en: What you yourself think about something.
flashcards.example_en: In my opinion, the most important invention of all time is the wheel.
flashcards.example_vi: Theo em, phát minh quan trọng nhất mọi thời đại là bánh xe.

flashcards.back_en: Why you think something; what makes it true.
flashcards.example_en: Start your essay with your strongest reason.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy mở đầu bài luận bằng lý do thuyết phục nhất của em.

flashcards.back_en: Good at making people agree with you.
flashcards.example_en: The aim of a persuasive essay is to make the reader agree with you.
flashcards.example_vi: Mục đích của bài luận thuyết phục là khiến người đọc đồng ý với em.

flashcards.back_en: To need something in order to manage.
flashcards.example_en: We depend on the wheel for all our transport.
flashcards.example_vi: Chúng ta phụ thuộc vào bánh xe cho mọi phương tiện đi lại.

flashcards.back_en: Working well without wasting time or effort.
flashcards.example_en: Carrying heavy things without wheels isn't very fast or efficient.
flashcards.example_vi: Mang vác đồ nặng mà không có bánh xe thì không nhanh và không hiệu quả.

flashcards.back_en: How far it is between two places.
flashcards.example_en: It is very difficult to travel long distances without wheels.
flashcards.example_vi: Đi những quãng đường dài mà không có bánh xe thì rất khó.

flashcards.back_en: A wheel with teeth that makes a machine turn.
flashcards.example_en: The wheels that make machines in factories work are called cogs.
flashcards.example_vi: Những bánh xe làm cho máy móc trong nhà máy hoạt động được gọi là bánh răng.

flashcards.back_en: A person who makes something completely new.
flashcards.example_en: The lady wanted to find the best young inventor in the town.
flashcards.example_vi: Người phụ nữ muốn tìm ra nhà phát minh nhỏ tuổi giỏi nhất thị trấn.

flashcards.back_en: Clear, so you can see through it.
flashcards.example_en: Garth's design covered his head in a magnificent transparent dome.
flashcards.example_vi: Thiết kế của Garth trùm lên đầu cậu một mái vòm trong suốt tuyệt đẹp.

flashcards.back_en: To look at someone in a cruel way.
flashcards.example_en: Todd sneered at Garth and said the Bodybrella looked dumb.
flashcards.example_vi: Todd cười khinh Garth và bảo chiếc Bodybrella trông thật ngớ ngẩn.

flashcards.back_en: Cruel comments.
flashcards.example_en: The mocking jibes rang in Garth's ears long after the boys had gone.
flashcards.example_vi: Những lời chế giễu cay độc còn vang bên tai Garth rất lâu sau khi mấy cậu kia đi khỏi.

flashcards.back_en: Feeling stupid in front of other people.
flashcards.example_en: Trembling and humiliated, Garth picked up his battered invention.
flashcards.example_vi: Run rẩy và tủi hổ, Garth nhặt phát minh đã móp méo của mình lên.

flashcards.back_en: Horrible, disgusting.
flashcards.example_en: Maybe the repugnant Todd Barker was right after all.
flashcards.example_vi: Có lẽ tên Todd Barker đáng ghét ấy nói đúng thật.

flashcards.back_en: A paper or card you use instead of money in a shop.
flashcards.example_en: Each of the three winners will get a big voucher to spend on gadgets.
flashcards.example_vi: Mỗi người trong ba người thắng cuộc sẽ nhận một phiếu mua hàng lớn để mua đồ công nghệ.

flashcards.back_en: Spending money on something that isn't useful.
flashcards.example_en: It's a waste of money to buy trainers you never wear.
flashcards.example_vi: Mua giày thể thao mà chẳng bao giờ đi là phí tiền.

flashcards.back_en: To have enough money to buy something.
flashcards.example_en: Should you buy the most expensive tablet you can afford?
flashcards.example_vi: Em có nên mua chiếc máy tính bảng đắt nhất mà em đủ tiền mua không?

flashcards.back_en: To continue to be in good condition.
flashcards.example_en: If something is made well, it usually lasts longer.
flashcards.example_vi: Nếu một món đồ được làm tốt thì thường bền lâu hơn.

flashcards.back_en: An organisation that provides money and help.
flashcards.example_en: I'd give the money to a charity that helps animals and wildlife.
flashcards.example_vi: Em sẽ tặng số tiền đó cho một tổ chức từ thiện giúp đỡ động vật hoang dã.

flashcards.back_en: To keep money so you can use it in the future.
flashcards.example_en: I save some of my pocket money for something special.
flashcards.example_vi: Em để dành một phần tiền tiêu vặt cho một thứ đặc biệt.

flashcards.back_en: A type of product made by a particular company.
flashcards.example_en: The expensive brands are made better than the cheap ones.
flashcards.example_vi: Những thương hiệu đắt tiền được làm tốt hơn loại rẻ.

flashcards.back_en: The amount of money needed for something.
flashcards.example_en: Can you calculate the total cost of the ingredients?
flashcards.example_vi: Em có tính được tổng chi phí nguyên liệu không?

flashcards.back_en: An amount of something out of 100.
flashcards.example_en: Ava and Alex sold 95 percent of their brownies.
flashcards.example_vi: Ava và Alex đã bán được 95 phần trăm số bánh brownie.

flashcards.back_en: A unit of weight; 1,000 grams.
flashcards.example_en: The recipe needs 1.1 kilograms of butter for 100 brownies.
flashcards.example_vi: Công thức cần 1,1 ki-lô-gam bơ cho 100 chiếc bánh.

flashcards.back_en: To work out an amount using numbers.
flashcards.example_en: Calculate the new costs if you make 200 brownies.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy tính chi phí mới nếu em làm 200 chiếc bánh.

flashcards.back_en: One of the foods you use to make a dish.
flashcards.example_en: What are the new measurements for each ingredient?
flashcards.example_vi: Định lượng mới cho mỗi nguyên liệu là bao nhiêu?

flashcards.back_en: The money you have left after you take away your costs.
flashcards.example_en: They sold all the brownies and made a profit of $80.00.
flashcards.example_vi: Họ bán hết bánh và thu được lợi nhuận 80 đô la.

flashcards.back_en: A part of a whole number, such as 1/2 or 1/5.
flashcards.example_en: You can write 50% as the fraction 1/2.
flashcards.example_vi: Em có thể viết 50% dưới dạng phân số 1/2.

flashcards.back_en: To collect money by doing an activity.
flashcards.example_en: Have you ever done activities to raise money for charity?
flashcards.example_vi: Em đã bao giờ làm hoạt động để quyên tiền cho từ thiện chưa?

flashcards.back_en: The money that a country uses.
flashcards.example_en: How much is $825 US in the currency of your country?
flashcards.example_vi: 825 đô la Mỹ bằng bao nhiêu theo tiền tệ nước em?

flashcards.back_en: An idea you offer for other people to think about.
flashcards.example_en: What suggestion does Nacho make to the class?
flashcards.example_vi: Nacho đưa ra đề xuất gì cho cả lớp?

flashcards.back_en: A talk in which people share their ideas.
flashcards.example_en: In a discussion, use phrases to introduce your points.
flashcards.example_vi: Trong một cuộc thảo luận, hãy dùng các cụm từ để mở đầu ý của em.

flashcards.back_en: To answer or react to what someone says.
flashcards.example_en: Marina responds to Nacho's idea with an idea of her own.
flashcards.example_vi: Marina đáp lại ý tưởng của Nacho bằng một ý tưởng của riêng cô ấy.

flashcards.back_en: To talk with other people until you all agree.
flashcards.example_en: When you negotiate, you make suggestions and listen to other people.
flashcards.example_vi: Khi thương lượng, em đưa ra đề xuất và lắng nghe người khác.

flashcards.back_en: Money your family gives you to spend yourself.
flashcards.example_en: Do you get pocket money from your family?
flashcards.example_vi: Em có được gia đình cho tiền tiêu vặt không?

flashcards.back_en: To understand how much something is really worth.
flashcards.example_en: If you don't buy anything yourself, you don't appreciate the cost of things.
flashcards.example_vi: Nếu không tự mua thứ gì, em sẽ không hiểu được giá trị của đồ vật.

flashcards.back_en: To look after something carefully and keep control of it.
flashcards.example_en: Pocket money teaches us to manage money ourselves.
flashcards.example_vi: Tiền tiêu vặt dạy chúng em tự quản lý tiền bạc.

flashcards.back_en: The amount of money you pay for something.
flashcards.example_en: It makes you compare prices and find ways to buy things more cheaply.
flashcards.example_vi: Nó khiến em so sánh giá cả và tìm cách mua đồ rẻ hơn.

flashcards.back_en: Costing a lot of money.
flashcards.example_en: I didn't know how expensive video games were until I bought one.
flashcards.example_vi: Em không biết trò chơi điện tử đắt đến thế cho tới khi tự mua một cái.

flashcards.back_en: The last part of an essay, which sums up the main point.
flashcards.example_en: The conclusion of Ismail's essay summarises his main point.
flashcards.example_vi: Phần kết luận trong bài luận của Ismail tóm tắt lại ý chính.

flashcards.back_en: Someone who has more than a thousand million pounds or dollars.
flashcards.example_en: 'You are a billionaire, boy,' said Mr Spud.
flashcards.example_vi: 'Con là tỉ phú mà, con trai,' ông Spud nói.

flashcards.back_en: A type of servant who works in a big house.
flashcards.example_en: For a while they had a butler called Otis who was also an orang-utan.
flashcards.example_vi: Có một dạo nhà họ có một quản gia tên Otis, mà lại là một con đười ươi.

flashcards.back_en: A special glass for drinks.
flashcards.example_en: He and his dad drank orange squash from priceless antique goblets.
flashcards.example_vi: Cậu và bố uống nước cam từ những chiếc ly cổ vô giá.

flashcards.back_en: Expensive and meant for rich people.
flashcards.example_en: 'I can afford to send you to the poshest schools in the world.'
flashcards.example_vi: 'Bố đủ tiền cho con học những trường sang trọng nhất thế giới.'

flashcards.back_en: Looking sad and alone.
flashcards.example_en: Mr Spud looked forlorn because there was nothing left to buy his son.
flashcards.example_vi: Ông Spud trông buồn thiu vì chẳng còn gì để mua cho con trai nữa.

flashcards.back_en: The angry feeling you get when you can't have what you want.
flashcards.example_en: 'Boring! Boring! Boring!' Joe stamped his feet in frustration.
flashcards.example_vi: 'Chán ngắt! Chán ngắt! Chán ngắt!' Joe giậm chân bực bội.

flashcards.back_en: Not real; made to look like the real thing.
flashcards.example_en: In the grounds there was a ski-slope with mountains of fake snow.
flashcards.example_vi: Trong khuôn viên có một dốc trượt tuyết với những núi tuyết giả.

flashcards.back_en: A person who helps people move properly again after an injury.
flashcards.example_en: The physiotherapist showed my brother some exercises for his knee.
flashcards.example_vi: Chuyên viên vật lý trị liệu chỉ cho anh trai tôi vài bài tập cho đầu gối.

flashcards.back_en: A doctor for animals.
flashcards.example_en: We took our cat to the vet when she stopped eating.
flashcards.example_vi: Chúng tôi đưa mèo đi khám thú y khi nó bỏ ăn.

flashcards.back_en: A person whose job is writing the code that makes computers work.
flashcards.example_en: My aunt is a computer programmer and she writes code all day.
flashcards.example_vi: Dì tôi là lập trình viên máy tính và cả ngày dì viết mã.

flashcards.back_en: A person who designs, builds or repairs machines, roads or bridges.
flashcards.example_en: I'm really good at fixing things, so I'd like to be an engineer.
flashcards.example_vi: Em rất giỏi sửa đồ nên em muốn làm kỹ sư.

flashcards.back_en: A film that shows real animals and plants in nature.
flashcards.example_en: We watched a wildlife documentary about penguins last night.
flashcards.example_vi: Tối qua chúng tôi xem một phim tài liệu về động vật hoang dã nói về chim cánh cụt.

flashcards.back_en: Damage to your body that happens while you are playing sport.
flashcards.example_en: A physiotherapist can help you get better after a sports injury.
flashcards.example_vi: Chuyên viên vật lý trị liệu có thể giúp bạn hồi phục sau chấn thương thể thao.

flashcards.back_en: Time spent working in a real job so that you learn what it is like.
flashcards.example_en: She did two weeks of work experience at an animal hospital.
flashcards.example_vi: Chị ấy đi thực tế hai tuần ở một bệnh viện thú y.

flashcards.back_en: Work that you do to help other people, without being paid.
flashcards.example_en: Voluntary work at the park helped him get his first job.
flashcards.example_vi: Công việc tình nguyện ở công viên giúp anh ấy có việc làm đầu tiên.

flashcards.back_en: Showing up in the dark when light shines on it.
flashcards.example_en: The white stripe is reflective, so drivers can see you at night.
flashcards.example_vi: Sọc trắng có phản quang nên người lái xe nhìn thấy bạn vào ban đêm.

flashcards.back_en: An important part of something.
flashcards.example_en: The best feature of the jacket is its inside pockets.
flashcards.example_vi: Điểm hay nhất của chiếc áo khoác là các túi bên trong.

flashcards.back_en: To be right for a person, a purpose or a situation.
flashcards.example_en: The loose design will suit people who are all shapes and sizes.
flashcards.example_vi: Kiểu dáng rộng rãi này hợp với mọi vóc dáng và kích cỡ.

flashcards.back_en: A long narrow band of colour.
flashcards.example_en: The tracksuit is dark blue with a green stripe along the sleeves.
flashcards.example_vi: Bộ đồ thể thao màu xanh đậm với một sọc xanh lá chạy dọc tay áo.

flashcards.back_en: A fastener with two rows of teeth that lock together.
flashcards.example_en: The trousers have zips at the bottom and zipped pockets on the side.
flashcards.example_vi: Chiếc quần có khoá kéo ở gấu và túi có khoá ở hai bên.

flashcards.back_en: Not letting water through.
flashcards.example_en: Waterproof material from the ankle to the knee keeps the trousers dry.
flashcards.example_vi: Lớp vải chống nước từ mắt cá đến đầu gối giữ cho ống quần luôn khô.

flashcards.back_en: A small design that shows which company something belongs to.
flashcards.example_en: The jacket has the post office logo at the top on the front right.
flashcards.example_vi: Áo khoác có logo bưu điện ở phía trên bên phải mặt trước.

flashcards.back_en: Able to get longer or wider and then go back to its shape.
flashcards.example_en: The fabric is stretchy, so the uniform is comfortable to work in.
flashcards.example_vi: Vải co giãn nên bộ đồng phục mặc làm việc rất thoải mái.

flashcards.back_en: A trip outside a spacecraft while it is in space.
flashcards.example_en: Karina has done three spacewalks so far.
flashcards.example_vi: Đến giờ Karina đã thực hiện ba lần đi bộ ngoài không gian.

flashcards.back_en: The force that pulls things down towards a planet.
flashcards.example_en: There is almost no gravity on the space station, so everything floats.
flashcards.example_vi: Trên trạm vũ trụ gần như không có trọng lực nên mọi thứ đều lơ lửng.

flashcards.back_en: Travelling to a new place to find out what is there.
flashcards.example_en: She has always been interested in space exploration and science.
flashcards.example_vi: Cô ấy luôn hứng thú với việc khám phá vũ trụ và khoa học.

flashcards.back_en: A little dangerous.
flashcards.example_en: Working outside the space station is risky, so astronauts train for years.
flashcards.example_vi: Làm việc bên ngoài trạm vũ trụ khá nguy hiểm nên phi hành gia phải luyện tập nhiều năm.

flashcards.back_en: Sure that you can do something well.
flashcards.example_en: You have to be confident to speak in front of the whole school.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn phải tự tin mới nói được trước toàn trường.

flashcards.back_en: Showing that you enjoy something very much.
flashcards.example_en: She is enthusiastic about her job and talks about it all the time.
flashcards.example_vi: Cô ấy rất hào hứng với công việc và lúc nào cũng nói về nó.

flashcards.back_en: Ready to try new and exciting things.
flashcards.example_en: Astronauts are adventurous people who like new challenges.
flashcards.example_vi: Phi hành gia là những người thích phiêu lưu và ưa thử thách mới.

flashcards.back_en: Putting a lot of effort into your work or study.
flashcards.example_en: You need to be hardworking to train as an astronaut.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn phải chăm chỉ mới theo được khoá huấn luyện phi hành gia.

flashcards.back_en: A person who looks after the animals in a zoo.
flashcards.example_en: We are looking for a friendly zookeeper to lead our team of animal carers.
flashcards.example_vi: Chúng tôi đang tìm một người trông thú thân thiện để dẫn dắt nhóm chăm sóc động vật.

flashcards.back_en: A performer who does jumps and balances, often high in the air.
flashcards.example_en: An acrobat must be able to balance on one leg.
flashcards.example_vi: Diễn viên nhào lộn phải đứng thăng bằng được trên một chân.

flashcards.back_en: A person who is trying to get a job.
flashcards.example_en: Which candidate is the most suitable for this job?
flashcards.example_vi: Ứng viên nào phù hợp nhất với công việc này?

flashcards.back_en: Able to bend and move your body easily.
flashcards.example_en: You must be very flexible, strong and athletic to join our troupe.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn phải rất dẻo dai, khoẻ và có thể lực tốt mới vào được đoàn của chúng tôi.

flashcards.back_en: Strong, fit and good at sport.
flashcards.example_en: Acrobats are athletic and they train every day.
flashcards.example_vi: Diễn viên nhào lộn có thể lực tốt và họ tập luyện mỗi ngày.

flashcards.back_en: Difficult, but in a way that is interesting.
flashcards.example_en: This job is more challenging than it looks!
flashcards.example_vi: Công việc này khó hơn vẻ ngoài của nó nhiều!

flashcards.back_en: A person whose job is building houses and other buildings.
flashcards.example_en: You could be a builder building houses, brick after brick.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn có thể làm thợ xây, xây nhà từng viên gạch một.

flashcards.back_en: A person whose job is making walls and ceilings smooth.
flashcards.example_en: A plasterer smooths the walls in bedrooms, kitchens and halls.
flashcards.example_vi: Thợ trát làm phẳng những bức tường trong phòng ngủ, bếp và sảnh.

flashcards.back_en: A person who cuts and styles people's hair.
flashcards.example_en: You could be a hairdresser and cut people's hair.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn có thể làm thợ làm tóc và cắt tóc cho mọi người.

flashcards.back_en: A person who performs in plays or films.
flashcards.example_en: You could be an actor and dress up all day.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn có thể làm diễn viên và hoá trang cả ngày.

flashcards.back_en: A doctor who looks after people's teeth.
flashcards.example_en: The dentist fixed my cracked tooth in ten minutes.
flashcards.example_vi: Nha sĩ chữa chiếc răng bị nứt của tôi chỉ trong mười phút.

flashcards.back_en: A person who studies science or does research.
flashcards.example_en: A scientist is finding new medicines that help mend the ill.
flashcards.example_vi: Một nhà khoa học đang tìm ra những loại thuốc mới giúp chữa lành người bệnh.

flashcards.back_en: Bumpy and uneven, not straight or flat.
flashcards.example_en: The plasterer smoothed the wonky wall until it was flat.
flashcards.example_vi: Người thợ trát làm phẳng bức tường gồ ghề cho đến khi nhẵn mịn.

flashcards.back_en: Hot melted rock that flows out of a volcano.
flashcards.example_en: We were almost a kilometre away when the lava was rolling towards us.
flashcards.example_vi: Chúng tôi ở cách gần một ki-lô-mét khi dòng dung nham đang trôi về phía mình.

flashcards.back_en: To throw out lava, ash and gas suddenly.
flashcards.example_en: The volcano erupted while we were filming nearby.
flashcards.example_vi: Ngọn núi lửa phun trào khi chúng tôi đang quay phim gần đó.

flashcards.back_en: To burst apart suddenly with a loud noise.
flashcards.example_en: The volcano suddenly exploded and we ran back to the car.
flashcards.example_vi: Núi lửa bất ngờ nổ tung và chúng tôi chạy về phía xe.

flashcards.back_en: The large round hole in the top of a volcano.
flashcards.example_en: Smoke was rising from the crater at the top of the mountain.
flashcards.example_vi: Khói đang bốc lên từ miệng núi lửa trên đỉnh.

flashcards.back_en: The soft grey powder that is left after something burns.
flashcards.example_en: A volcanic eruption can throw ash high into the air.
flashcards.example_vi: Một đợt phun trào núi lửa có thể hất tro bụi lên cao trong không khí.

flashcards.back_en: A long thin line where something has split open.
flashcards.example_en: Houses were disappearing as the earth opened up in huge cracks.
flashcards.example_vi: Những ngôi nhà biến mất khi mặt đất nứt toác thành những khe lớn.

flashcards.back_en: A very large sea wave caused by an earthquake or an eruption.
flashcards.example_en: If volcanoes erupt near water, they can cause a tsunami.
flashcards.example_vi: Nếu núi lửa phun trào gần nước, chúng có thể gây ra sóng thần.

flashcards.back_en: To make something exist, or to take shape.
flashcards.example_en: The tiny drops of water cool and form thunder clouds.
flashcards.example_vi: Những giọt nước li ti nguội đi và tạo thành mây dông.

flashcards.back_en: A measure of the amount of heat in something.
flashcards.example_en: At the top of the cloud the temperature is very cold.
flashcards.example_vi: Ở đỉnh đám mây, nhiệt độ rất lạnh.

flashcards.back_en: The amount of electricity that something has.
flashcards.example_en: The tiny ice crystals have a positive charge.
flashcards.example_vi: Những tinh thể băng li ti mang điện tích dương.

flashcards.back_en: To knock against something by accident.
flashcards.example_en: The storm winds make the pieces of ice bump into each other.
flashcards.example_vi: Gió bão làm các mảnh băng va vào nhau.

flashcards.back_en: To hit something suddenly and hard.
flashcards.example_en: Lightning often strikes trees, towers and sometimes even people.
flashcards.example_vi: Sét thường đánh vào cây, tháp và đôi khi cả con người.

flashcards.back_en: Having a lot of water in the air.
flashcards.example_en: Warm ground makes warm, humid air which rises to the sky.
flashcards.example_vi: Mặt đất ấm tạo ra luồng không khí ấm và ẩm bốc lên trời.

flashcards.back_en: A very small flash of fire or electricity.
flashcards.example_en: A huge spark of lightning happens inside the cloud.
flashcards.example_vi: Một tia lửa điện khổng lồ loé lên bên trong đám mây.

flashcards.back_en: To stay somewhere safe, away from danger or bad weather.
flashcards.example_en: If you can't shelter in a building, shelter in a car.
flashcards.example_vi: Nếu không trú được trong nhà, hãy trú trong ô tô.

flashcards.back_en: To lower your body towards the ground.
flashcards.example_en: As soon as the shaking starts, get down on your hands and knees.
flashcards.example_vi: Ngay khi mặt đất rung, hãy hạ người xuống bằng hai tay và hai đầu gối.

flashcards.back_en: To put something over another thing to protect it.
flashcards.example_en: Cover your head with your arms when the shaking starts.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy lấy tay che đầu khi mặt đất bắt đầu rung.

flashcards.back_en: To move along on your hands and knees.
flashcards.example_en: Crawl under a strong table and stay there.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy bò xuống dưới một chiếc bàn chắc chắn và ở yên đó.

flashcards.back_en: To keep tight hold of something.
flashcards.example_en: Hold on to the table legs until the shaking stops.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy bám chặt chân bàn cho đến khi hết rung lắc.

flashcards.back_en: To move quickly from side to side or up and down.
flashcards.example_en: The whole building shook for about twenty seconds.
flashcards.example_vi: Cả toà nhà rung lắc khoảng hai mươi giây.

flashcards.back_en: A break in the Earth's surface.
flashcards.example_en: Earthquakes happen in places where there is a fault line.
flashcards.example_vi: Động đất xảy ra ở những nơi có đường đứt gãy.

flashcards.back_en: The huge blocks of moving rock under the Earth's surface.
flashcards.example_en: When the tectonic plates break free, the pressure is released.
flashcards.example_vi: Khi các mảng kiến tạo bung ra, áp lực được giải phóng.

flashcards.back_en: The force that something makes when it pushes.
flashcards.example_en: If the rocks get stuck, a lot of pressure builds up.
flashcards.example_vi: Nếu các khối đá bị kẹt, áp lực rất lớn sẽ dồn lại.

flashcards.back_en: Able to make you very ill, or to kill you.
flashcards.example_en: The cloud was a poisonous mixture of ash and gas.
flashcards.example_vi: Đám mây là một hỗn hợp độc hại gồm tro và khí.

flashcards.back_en: Two or more different things put together.
flashcards.example_en: Concrete is a mixture of sand, stone and water.
flashcards.example_vi: Bê tông là hỗn hợp của cát, đá và nước.

flashcards.back_en: To damage something so badly that it no longer exists.
flashcards.example_en: The ash cloud destroyed houses and killed thousands of people.
flashcards.example_vi: Đám mây tro đã phá huỷ nhà cửa và cướp đi sinh mạng hàng nghìn người.

flashcards.back_en: Very old, from a time long ago.
flashcards.example_en: My history project is about the ancient Romans.
flashcards.example_vi: Bài tập lịch sử của em nói về người La Mã cổ đại.

flashcards.back_en: Tools that you use for cooking and eating.
flashcards.example_en: You can still see bread, bottles and cooking utensils in the old city.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn vẫn có thể thấy bánh mì, chai lọ và dụng cụ nấu ăn trong thành phố cổ.

flashcards.back_en: A line of things or people next to each other.
flashcards.example_en: You can see rows of houses and shops just as they were long ago.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn có thể nhìn thấy những dãy nhà và cửa hàng y như thuở xưa.

flashcards.back_en: A strong feeling such as joy, fear or sadness.
flashcards.example_en: My visit to Pompeii made me feel so many different emotions.
flashcards.example_vi: Chuyến thăm Pompeii khiến em trải qua rất nhiều cảm xúc khác nhau.

flashcards.back_en: The time when the sun rises in the morning.
flashcards.example_en: We got up at dawn to watch the sun come up over the sea.
flashcards.example_vi: Chúng tôi dậy lúc bình minh để ngắm mặt trời lên trên biển.

flashcards.back_en: The time in the evening when the sun goes down.
flashcards.example_en: Sunsets are the loveliest things I know.
flashcards.example_vi: Hoàng hôn là điều đáng yêu nhất mà tôi biết.

flashcards.back_en: A soft steady light.
flashcards.example_en: In the evening the sky keeps the warm glow of the sun.
flashcards.example_vi: Buổi tối bầu trời vẫn giữ lại ánh sáng ấm áp của mặt trời.

flashcards.back_en: Very hot and bright.
flashcards.example_en: Thanks for those blazing days on beaches.
flashcards.example_vi: Cảm ơn vì những ngày nắng chói chang trên bãi biển.

flashcards.back_en: Making fruit ready to eat.
flashcards.example_en: Thank you for ripening apples, pears and peaches.
flashcards.example_vi: Cảm ơn vì đã làm chín táo, lê và đào.

flashcards.back_en: Grey and cold.
flashcards.example_en: On dismal days the sun waits calmly behind the cloud.
flashcards.example_vi: Vào những ngày xám lạnh, mặt trời điềm tĩnh chờ sau đám mây.

flashcards.back_en: Strong and brave.
flashcards.example_en: The sun shares out its noble glow with the whole world.
flashcards.example_vi: Mặt trời chia sẻ thứ ánh sáng mạnh mẽ của mình với cả thế giới.

flashcards.back_en: The story of a film, book or game: what happens and in what order.
flashcards.example_en: The plot is really exciting because you never know who the hero can trust.
flashcards.example_vi: Cốt truyện rất hấp dẫn vì bạn không bao giờ biết người hùng có thể tin ai.

flashcards.back_en: Drawings or computer images that are made to move.
flashcards.example_en: The animation in this cartoon is so smooth that the animals look real.
flashcards.example_vi: Phần hoạt hình trong phim này mượt đến mức các con vật trông như thật.

flashcards.back_en: All the music used in a film or a game.
flashcards.example_en: The soundtrack is awesome, so I listen to it while I do my homework.
flashcards.example_vi: Nhạc phim hay tuyệt, nên tớ mở nghe trong lúc làm bài tập.

flashcards.back_en: The pictures a computer or a game makes on the screen.
flashcards.example_en: The graphics are amazing on the new game.
flashcards.example_vi: Đồ hoạ của trò chơi mới đẹp đến kinh ngạc.

flashcards.back_en: Tricks that show on screen things a camera cannot really film.
flashcards.example_en: The special effects brought life-like dinosaurs to the screen.
flashcards.example_vi: Kỹ xảo đã đưa những con khủng long y như thật lên màn ảnh.

flashcards.back_en: All the actors who appear in a film or a play.
flashcards.example_en: The cast of this film is small: only four actors ever speak.
flashcards.example_vi: Dàn diễn viên của phim rất ít: chỉ có bốn người có thoại.

flashcards.back_en: The clothes an actor wears to play a character.
flashcards.example_en: The actors wore space costumes made of silver cloth.
flashcards.example_vi: Các diễn viên mặc trang phục phi hành gia bằng vải bạc.

flashcards.back_en: The place and the time where a story happens.
flashcards.example_en: The setting of the story is an island theme park full of dinosaurs.
flashcards.example_vi: Bối cảnh của câu chuyện là một công viên trên đảo đầy khủng long.

flashcards.back_en: A machine that shows moving pictures on a screen.
flashcards.example_en: The first film projector showed moving pictures on a tiny screen inside the machine.
flashcards.example_vi: Chiếc máy chiếu phim đầu tiên chiếu hình ảnh chuyển động trên một màn hình nhỏ xíu bên trong máy.

flashcards.back_en: A film with no recorded sound.
flashcards.example_en: From 1907, people watched silent films in cinemas on big screens.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ năm 1907, người ta xem phim câm trên màn ảnh lớn trong rạp.

flashcards.back_en: The first films that had sound and dialogue.
flashcards.example_en: Films with sound appeared in 1927 and people called them talkies.
flashcards.example_vi: Phim có tiếng xuất hiện năm 1927 và người ta gọi chúng là phim nói.

flashcards.back_en: The look on someone's face that shows what they feel.
flashcards.example_en: Silent film actors used their facial expressions to show what was happening.
flashcards.example_vi: Diễn viên phim câm dùng nét mặt để cho thấy chuyện gì đang xảy ra.

flashcards.back_en: A person who plays the piano.
flashcards.example_en: The only sound in the cinema came from a pianist near the screen.
flashcards.example_vi: Âm thanh duy nhất trong rạp phát ra từ một người chơi dương cầm cạnh màn ảnh.

flashcards.back_en: A plan that says when things happen.
flashcards.example_en: Our screen-time schedule gives each of us one hour a day.
flashcards.example_vi: Lịch dùng màn hình của nhà tớ cho mỗi người một tiếng mỗi ngày.

flashcards.back_en: Not able to stop doing something.
flashcards.example_en: Too much screen time can make you addicted to your device.
flashcards.example_vi: Dùng màn hình quá nhiều có thể khiến bạn nghiện thiết bị.

flashcards.back_en: Friendly and happy to be with other people.
flashcards.example_en: Screens can stop you being sociable with the people around you.
flashcards.example_vi: Màn hình có thể khiến bạn ít giao tiếp với những người xung quanh.

flashcards.back_en: Easily made angry.
flashcards.example_en: If I don't sleep properly, I'm bad-tempered all morning.
flashcards.example_vi: Nếu ngủ không ngon, tớ cáu bẳn suốt cả buổi sáng.

flashcards.back_en: To stop someone paying attention to something.
flashcards.example_en: Games on my phone distract me from my school work.
flashcards.example_vi: Mấy trò chơi trong điện thoại làm tớ xao nhãng việc học.

flashcards.back_en: The most that is allowed.
flashcards.example_en: You have a limit of one hour of screen time on a school day.
flashcards.example_vi: Em có giới hạn một tiếng dùng màn hình vào ngày đi học.

flashcards.back_en: To breathe out slowly to show you are sad or tired.
flashcards.example_en: 'Oh no, not again!' sighed Dad.
flashcards.example_vi: 'Ôi không, lại nữa rồi!' bố thở dài.

flashcards.back_en: To laugh quietly in an unkind way.
flashcards.example_en: 'Here's a good place for a tent… hee hee!' sniggered Boris.
flashcards.example_vi: 'Đây là chỗ dựng lều tốt đấy… hi hi!' Boris cười khẩy.

flashcards.back_en: To say something very firmly when someone disagrees.
flashcards.example_en: 'No, Boris, I insist! You must sleep there,' said Horis.
flashcards.example_vi: 'Không, Boris, tớ nhất định đấy! Cậu phải ngủ ở đó,' Horis nói.

flashcards.back_en: To speak very quietly.
flashcards.example_en: 'Look at that ants' nest,' whispered Horis.
flashcards.example_vi: 'Nhìn cái tổ kiến kia kìa,' Horis thì thầm.

flashcards.back_en: To say that you will certainly do something.
flashcards.example_en: 'You'll love camping! Just think of all the fun we'll have,' promised Dad.
flashcards.example_vi: 'Con sẽ mê cắm trại cho mà xem! Cứ nghĩ tới bao nhiêu trò vui đi,' bố hứa.

flashcards.back_en: One short part of a film or a play.
flashcards.example_en: In Scene 2, Dad and the boys look for a place for the tent.
flashcards.example_vi: Ở cảnh 2, bố và hai cậu con trai đi tìm chỗ dựng lều.

flashcards.back_en: A row of drawings that plans the scenes of a film.
flashcards.example_en: We made a storyboard with six scenes for our film.
flashcards.example_vi: Chúng tớ vẽ một bảng phân cảnh gồm sáu cảnh cho bộ phim.

flashcards.back_en: A place out of the sunlight.
flashcards.example_en: Tina moved back from the water to the shade of the palm trees.
flashcards.example_vi: Tina lùi khỏi mép nước, vào bóng râm của những cây cọ.

flashcards.back_en: To come out of somewhere.
flashcards.example_en: A lizard emerged from the mangrove roots and peered at her.
flashcards.example_vi: Một con thằn lằn chui ra từ đám rễ đước và nhìn chằm chằm vào cô bé.

flashcards.back_en: At the back; used about an animal's back legs.
flashcards.example_en: The lizard stood on its hind legs, balancing on its thick tail.
flashcards.example_vi: Con thằn lằn đứng trên hai chân sau, giữ thăng bằng bằng cái đuôi dày.

flashcards.back_en: The inside part of your hand.
flashcards.example_en: She could feel its little toes pinching the skin of her palm.
flashcards.example_vi: Cô bé cảm thấy những ngón chân bé xíu của nó bấu vào da lòng bàn tay.

flashcards.back_en: How heavy something is.
flashcards.example_en: She felt the surprising weight of the animal pressing her arm down.
flashcards.example_vi: Cô bé cảm nhận sức nặng bất ngờ của con vật đè tay mình xuống.

flashcards.back_en: To move quickly using your hands and feet.
flashcards.example_en: The lizard scrambled up her arm towards her face.
flashcards.example_vi: Con thằn lằn trèo nhoay nhoáy lên cánh tay, về phía mặt cô bé.

flashcards.back_en: Very tired.
flashcards.example_en: Tina ran until she was exhausted and then threw herself down on the sand.
flashcards.example_vi: Tina chạy đến kiệt sức rồi buông mình xuống cát.

flashcards.back_en: To make the short high sound a small bird makes.
flashcards.example_en: The lizard paused, cocked its head and chirped.
flashcards.example_vi: Con thằn lằn dừng lại, nghiêng đầu và kêu chiêm chiếp.

flashcards.back_en: A work of art shaped in three dimensions from stone, metal or other materials.
flashcards.example_en: The fish sculpture is made from old materials, not new ones.
flashcards.example_vi: Bức điêu khắc hình con cá được làm từ vật liệu cũ chứ không phải vật liệu mới.

flashcards.back_en: A large picture painted on a wall.
flashcards.example_en: The mural covers the metal wall with bright colours and a positive message.
flashcards.example_vi: Bức tranh tường phủ lên bức vách kim loại những màu sắc rực rỡ và một thông điệp tích cực.

flashcards.back_en: Cloth and other woven materials.
flashcards.example_en: The 3D artwork is made of metal and textiles.
flashcards.example_vi: Tác phẩm ba chiều này được làm bằng kim loại và vải dệt.

flashcards.back_en: A picture made from many small coloured pieces stuck together.
flashcards.example_en: The walls of the building are covered in coloured mosaics.
flashcards.example_vi: Những bức tường của toà nhà được phủ bằng các mảnh khảm nhiều màu.

flashcards.back_en: A strong, hard metal.
flashcards.example_en: The red sculpture in the square is made of steel.
flashcards.example_vi: Bức tượng đỏ ngoài quảng trường được làm bằng thép.

flashcards.back_en: Paint that comes out of a can as a fine mist.
flashcards.example_en: Street artists use spray paint to work quickly on a big wall.
flashcards.example_vi: Các nghệ sĩ đường phố dùng sơn xịt để vẽ nhanh trên bức tường lớn.

flashcards.back_en: A hard grey material used for building.
flashcards.example_en: The wall of the underpass was grey concrete until the artists painted it.
flashcards.example_vi: Bức tường của hầm đi bộ chỉ toàn bê tông xám cho tới khi các nghệ sĩ vẽ lên đó.

flashcards.back_en: A large group of musicians who play together.
flashcards.example_en: The Recycled Orchestra has performed concerts all over South America.
flashcards.example_vi: Dàn nhạc Tái Chế đã biểu diễn khắp Nam Mỹ.

flashcards.back_en: An instrument you play by pulling or rubbing the strings.
flashcards.example_en: Cola makes violins, cellos and guitars, which are all string instruments.
flashcards.example_vi: Chú Cola làm vi-ô-lông, xen-lô và ghi-ta, tất cả đều là nhạc cụ dây.

flashcards.back_en: An instrument you play by blowing into it.
flashcards.example_en: The saxophones and trumpets are wind instruments made from old pipes.
flashcards.example_vi: Kèn saxophone và kèn trumpet là nhạc cụ hơi, làm từ những ống nước cũ.

flashcards.back_en: Instruments you play by hitting them with your hand or a stick.
flashcards.example_en: The drums are percussion, and these ones are made from metal tins.
flashcards.example_vi: Trống thuộc bộ gõ, và những chiếc trống này được làm từ hộp thiếc.

flashcards.back_en: A place where rubbish from a town is dumped or buried.
flashcards.example_en: Cateura has mountains of landfill rubbish from the nearby capital city.
flashcards.example_vi: Cateura có những núi rác thải đổ về từ thành phố thủ đô gần đó.

flashcards.back_en: A person who makes things out of wood.
flashcards.example_en: A local carpenter made the first violin out of bits of rubbish.
flashcards.example_vi: Một bác thợ mộc trong vùng đã làm cây vi-ô-lông đầu tiên từ những mảnh rác.

flashcards.back_en: The design and style of buildings.
flashcards.example_en: Our city tour starts with the interesting architecture near the river.
flashcards.example_vi: Chuyến tham quan thành phố bắt đầu với những công trình kiến trúc thú vị bên sông.

flashcards.back_en: A model of a person or an animal made of stone or metal.
flashcards.example_en: There is a statue of a horse in front of the museum.
flashcards.example_vi: Có một bức tượng con ngựa ở trước bảo tàng.

flashcards.back_en: Belonging to the present time; modern.
flashcards.example_en: The park has a unique collection of contemporary sculpture.
flashcards.example_vi: Công viên có một bộ sưu tập điêu khắc đương đại độc đáo.

flashcards.back_en: A short class where you make or practise something.
flashcards.example_en: The three-hour family workshop starts at 2pm.
flashcards.example_vi: Buổi thực hành ba tiếng dành cho gia đình bắt đầu lúc 2 giờ chiều.

flashcards.back_en: Difficult jumps and balances done by trained performers.
flashcards.example_en: The circus opens with amazing acrobatics high above the stage.
flashcards.example_vi: Rạp xiếc mở màn bằng những màn nhào lộn tuyệt vời trên cao.

flashcards.back_en: A game in which you follow clues to find hidden things.
flashcards.example_en: Download the city map and join our Art Safari treasure hunt.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy tải bản đồ thành phố và tham gia trò săn tìm kho báu Art Safari.

flashcards.back_en: A plan of a journey that says where you go and when.
flashcards.example_en: Our itinerary starts at the sculpture park and ends at the museum.
flashcards.example_vi: Lịch trình của nhóm tớ bắt đầu ở công viên điêu khắc và kết thúc ở bảo tàng.

flashcards.back_en: Clean, bright and shiny.
flashcards.example_en: I am made of smooth concrete and gleaming glass.
flashcards.example_vi: Tôi được làm từ bê tông nhẵn mịn và kính sáng bóng.

flashcards.back_en: Reflecting light in a soft, beautiful way.
flashcards.example_en: I look out onto the shimmering ocean.
flashcards.example_vi: Tôi nhìn ra mặt biển lấp lánh.

flashcards.back_en: The deep blue colour of a precious stone.
flashcards.example_en: I am made of coloured mosaics and sapphire glass.
flashcards.example_vi: Tôi được làm từ những mảnh khảm màu và kính xanh lam.

flashcards.back_en: Lit up so that it looks brighter.
flashcards.example_en: The building is illuminated at night.
flashcards.example_vi: Toà nhà được thắp sáng rực vào ban đêm.

flashcards.back_en: Having a rounded shape.
flashcards.example_en: I am bright, shiny and curved.
flashcards.example_vi: Tôi sáng, bóng và uốn cong mềm mại.

flashcards.back_en: With a line that goes up and down like waves.
flashcards.example_en: I am wavy, strange and wonderful.
flashcards.example_vi: Tôi uốn lượn, kỳ lạ và tuyệt vời.

flashcards.back_en: Flat and even, with no rough parts.
flashcards.example_en: The concrete walls feel smooth under your hand.
flashcards.example_vi: Những bức tường bê tông sờ vào thấy nhẵn mịn.

flashcards.back_en: To laugh in a quiet, nervous way.
flashcards.example_en: A few students giggled when Willow showed her pink tree.
flashcards.example_vi: Vài bạn cười khúc khích khi Willow đưa ra bức tranh cây màu hồng.

flashcards.back_en: A very annoyed look on someone's face.
flashcards.example_en: Miss Hawthorn glanced at the picture, then turned away with a scowl.
flashcards.example_vi: Cô Hawthorn liếc nhìn bức tranh rồi quay đi với vẻ mặt cau có.

flashcards.back_en: To shake a little because you are cold or afraid.
flashcards.example_en: Willow shivered when her teacher looked at her.
flashcards.example_vi: Willow rùng mình khi cô giáo nhìn mình.

flashcards.back_en: To look at someone in an angry way.
flashcards.example_en: Miss Hawthorn's icy blue eyes glared at Willow.
flashcards.example_vi: Đôi mắt xanh lạnh lẽo của cô Hawthorn quắc lên nhìn Willow.

flashcards.back_en: An expression that shows you are annoyed or confused.
flashcards.example_en: 'Whoever heard of a pink tree?' Miss Hawthorn asked with a frown.
flashcards.example_vi: 'Ai mà nghe nói tới cây màu hồng bao giờ?' cô Hawthorn cau mày hỏi.

flashcards.back_en: To speak quietly so that people can hardly hear you.
flashcards.example_en: 'Horrid little girl,' she muttered as Willow skipped off.
flashcards.example_vi: 'Con bé đáng ghét,' cô lẩm bẩm khi Willow tung tăng chạy đi.

flashcards.back_en: To draw in a free, relaxed way, without planning.
flashcards.example_en: For the first time in her life, Miss Hawthorn doodled.
flashcards.example_vi: Lần đầu tiên trong đời, cô Hawthorn vẽ nguệch ngoạc cho vui.

quiz.stem_en: Complete the question: '___ you finished yet?'
quiz.why_en: Present perfect question with 'you' uses 'have' (p.13).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'Why ___ you drawn a football?'
quiz.why_en: The present perfect uses have or has with the past participle (p.13).

quiz.stem_en: Which sentence is in the present perfect?
quiz.why_en: Present perfect is have or has plus the past participle (p.13).

quiz.stem_en: Why does 'I have drawn a car' use the present perfect and not the past simple?

choices.en: The event happened a very long time ago
The event has not happened yet
The event is recent and the exact time does not matter

quiz.why_en: We use the present perfect for recent events when the time is not important (p.13).

quiz.stem_en: Complete the negative: 'I ___ been on a rollercoaster again!'
quiz.why_en: The negative present perfect is have not plus the past participle (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: Which question asks about someone's experience?

choices.en: Have you ever felt really proud of yourself?

quiz.why_en: 'Have you ever…?' asks about experience up to now (p.19).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the correct preposition: '… places ___ our planet'
quiz.why_en: The text uses 'places on our planet' (p.14).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'Lines of latitude circle the Earth ___ to the equator.'
quiz.why_en: They are parallel to the equator (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'Lines of longitude run ___ the North Pole ___ the South Pole.'
quiz.why_en: The text uses from … to with the two poles (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Which sentence follows the pattern verb + object + infinitive?

choices.en: My dad is a good swimmer.
My dad taught me to swim.

quiz.why_en: taught + me + to swim is verb + direct object + infinitive (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: Rewrite with the same pattern: 'My friend said I should go with him.' becomes:

choices.en: My friend asked going with him.
My friend asked me to go with him.
My friend asked that I go.

quiz.why_en: asked + me + to go matches the pattern in the text (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: A person who takes action to support their beliefs is called:
quiz.why_en: That is the definition matched in Activity 6 (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: 'To refuse to allow something' is the meaning of:
quiz.why_en: ban means to refuse to allow something (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'She works hard, so I really ___ her.'
quiz.why_en: admire means to think very well of someone (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: The internet, newspapers, TV and magazines are together called:
quiz.why_en: That is the definition given in Activity 6 (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: Which of these words is negative?
quiz.why_en: Activity 6 asks you to sort these words; bully is negative (p.13).

quiz.stem_en: What is a coordinate?

choices.en: A code that shows an exact position on a map
A line that circles the Earth
The most northern point of the Earth

quiz.why_en: A coordinate is a code to show exact positions on a map (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: What does 'vertical' mean?
quiz.why_en: The key words box gives 'standing upwards' (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: What is the noun form of the adjective 'proud'?
quiz.why_en: Activity 4 on the review page asks for these noun forms (p.19, p.26).

quiz.stem_en: What is the noun form of the adjective 'amazing'?
quiz.why_en: Olivia's text uses 'I looked at it in amazement' (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: The equator circles the Earth halfway between the poles. What is its line of latitude?
quiz.why_en: Its line of latitude is zero degrees (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Lines of latitude are about the same distance apart. How far apart are they?
quiz.why_en: They are the same distance apart, about 111 km (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Latitude is measured 0–90° north and south. How far is longitude measured east and west?
quiz.why_en: Lines of longitude are measured 0–180° east and west (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: What happens when a place lies between the lines on a map?

choices.en: The place cannot be given a coordinate
You round to the nearest whole degree
You use the nearest city instead
The degrees are divided into minutes and seconds

quiz.why_en: We divide the degrees into minutes and seconds (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Which phrase would you use to START a presentation?

choices.en: Today, I'm going to talk about…
To sum up, I chose to…
Since then, with her father, she…

quiz.why_en: The speaking tip box lists this as an opening phrase (p.17).

quiz.stem_en: Which phrase would you use to FINISH a presentation?

choices.en: Today, I'm going to talk about…
To sum up, I chose to…
As I said in my introduction…

quiz.why_en: 'To sum up' comes at the end (p.17).

quiz.stem_en: Why do you use sequencing words in a presentation?

choices.en: They make the words sound nicer
They help the audience follow the order of your ideas
They replace the need for facts

quiz.why_en: Use sequencing words to help your audience follow your presentation (p.17).

quiz.stem_en: Santok says the rollercoaster was 'exciting and terrifying at the same time'. What does this show?

choices.en: One experience can bring two opposite feelings at once
He did not enjoy any part of it
He had ridden one many times before

quiz.why_en: Santok describes both feelings in the same sentence (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: In A Girl Called Owl, why does the narrator think her name suits her?

choices.en: She keeps an owl as a pet
Her hair flicks like feathers and her nose is on the beaky side
She is very good at flying kites

quiz.why_en: She describes her hair and nose in the extract (p.20).

quiz.stem_en: introduction, education and presentation all end in the sound /ʃən/. Which sound does decision end in?

choices.en: /ʃən/, exactly the same as the others

quiz.why_en: -sion after a vowel is said /ʒən/, so decision is /dɪˈsɪʒən/ while the -tion words are /ʃən/ (p.17).

quiz.stem_en: Which piece of equipment do you hit over the net with a racquet in badminton?
quiz.why_en: You need a shuttlecock and a racquet to play badminton (p.29).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'Footballers wear ___ to protect the front of their lower legs.'
quiz.why_en: Shin pads are the hard pads that protect the front of the lower legs (p.29).

quiz.stem_en: In Shireen's survey, 6 classmates chose 'Meeting new friends', 5 chose 'Being part of a team', 4 chose 'Feeling healthy' and 3 chose 'Playing outside'. Which reason was the most popular?
quiz.why_en: Meeting new friends has the tallest bar, with 6 classmates (p.29).

quiz.stem_en: Complete the 1st conditional: 'If you drink plenty of water, you ___ hydrated.'
quiz.why_en: The 1st conditional is if + present simple, then will + verb (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'Your body won't grow well ___ you get plenty of protein.'
quiz.why_en: 'Unless' introduces the condition that stops the result happening (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: Which sentence means the same as 'Unless you eat enough carbohydrates, you won't have enough energy'?

choices.en: When you eat enough carbohydrates, you won't have enough energy
Because you eat enough carbohydrates, you won't have enough energy
Although you eat enough carbohydrates, you won't have enough energy
If you don't eat enough carbohydrates, you won't have enough energy

quiz.why_en: In the 1st conditional 'unless' means 'if … not' (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: Which kind of food repairs your muscles after exercise and helps your blood cells carry oxygen?
quiz.why_en: Chicken, fish, eggs and lentils give you the protein that repairs muscles (p.30).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'If you have a lot of food before exercise, you'll probably get ___.'
quiz.why_en: Eat something light like a banana instead, because it is easy to digest (p.30).

quiz.stem_en: Which part of the body is the joint between your foot and your leg?
quiz.why_en: The ankle joins the foot to the leg, so warm-ups often rotate it (p.32).

quiz.stem_en: Complete the strong warning: 'You ___ start running without warming up your leg muscles.'
quiz.why_en: We use mustn't to give strong advice against doing something (p.33).

quiz.stem_en: Which sentence gives advice rather than saying something is necessary?

choices.en: You should warm up your hips too.
We need to get your heart pumping before we begin.
You need to do about fifteen slow turns of the arms.
You mustn't rotate your arms too fast or you'll hurt them.

quiz.why_en: 'Should' gives advice, while 'need' says something is necessary (p.33).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'Simone Biles ___ born in Ohio, USA, in 1997.'
quiz.why_en: A finished event with a date takes the past simple (p.34).

quiz.stem_en: Which sentence uses the present perfect for an achievement that still counts today?

choices.en: She was one of the superstars at the Olympic Games in Rio in 2016.
A coach noticed her natural talent on a school trip when she was six.
She has won more World Championship medals than any other gymnast.
In 2014 she became the first woman in 40 years to win four gold medals.

quiz.why_en: Present perfect is have or has plus the past participle, for totals up to now (p.34).

quiz.stem_en: In the story of Simone Biles, her classmates teased her about her muscly legs. What does 'tease' mean here?

choices.en: To train someone for a competition
To choose someone for a national team
To look after a child in a new family
To laugh at someone in an unkind way

quiz.why_en: Instead of getting upset she felt proud, because being teased showed she was strong (p.35).

quiz.stem_en: In football, which player stands in the goal and stops shots?
quiz.why_en: The keeper guards the goal; Owusu's volley went past the United keeper (p.38).

quiz.stem_en: 'Owusu controlled the ball on his knee and volleyed it with amazing power. Half a second later it was crashing in off the crossbar.' What happened next in the match?

choices.en: The keeper caught the ball safely
Owusu scored, and the crowd exploded
The ball flew high over the goal
A defender cleared the ball away

quiz.why_en: The ball bounced about in the goal and the fans chanted the scorer's name (p.37).

quiz.stem_en: Complete with the present simple: 'Emperor penguins ___ in the Antarctic, one of the coldest places on Earth.'
quiz.why_en: The present simple describes what is always true, and 'penguins' is plural (p.45).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'The babies are a month old now. Soon they ___ to feed themselves.'
quiz.why_en: With the plural 'they' the present simple verb takes no -s (p.45).

quiz.stem_en: Which word means 'to stand very close together to keep warm'?
quiz.why_en: Penguins huddle in a big group so that the freezing wind cannot reach them (p.45).

quiz.stem_en: A food chain always begins with a plant, because the plant makes its own food from the energy of the sun. What is the plant called?
quiz.why_en: The plant is a producer: it produces its own food from sunlight (p.46).

quiz.stem_en: Rabbits, mice and grasshoppers eat only plants. What are animals like this called?
quiz.why_en: Primary consumers that eat only plants are called herbivores (p.46).

quiz.stem_en: Complete the relative clause: 'These creatures are small carnivores ___ main diet is meat.'
quiz.why_en: 'Whose' shows that the diet belongs to the carnivores (p.47).

quiz.stem_en: Lions, tigers, crocodiles, sharks and eagles have no natural enemies. Where are they in a food chain?

choices.en: They are the top predators at the end
They are the producers at the start
They are the herbivores that eat plants
They are the primary consumers in the middle

quiz.why_en: Animals with no natural enemies sit at the top of the chain as top predators (p.46).

quiz.stem_en: Frogs, lizards and spiders are carnivores that eat animals from the primary consumer group. What are they called?
quiz.why_en: The second level of consumer eats the animals in the first level (p.46).

quiz.stem_en: Put these words in order to make a question: 'grow / carnivorous plants / do / Where'.
quiz.why_en: A wh- question is question word + do / does + subject + verb (p.48).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'How ___ a carnivorous plant catch its prey?'
quiz.why_en: 'A carnivorous plant' is singular, so the question uses 'does' (p.48).

quiz.stem_en: 'When an insect crawls onto the Sundew's leaves, it is trapped by the thick sticky liquid. Then the leaf curls around the insect and crushes it.' What holds the insect first?

choices.en: The tiny hairs on the leaf

quiz.why_en: The sticky liquid traps the insect before the leaf curls up and crushes it (p.49).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'Amphibians are animals ___ can live in water and on land.'
quiz.why_en: 'Which' introduces a defining relative clause about things and animals (p.50).

quiz.stem_en: Amphibians are vertebrates. What does that tell you about them?

choices.en: They lay eggs with a hard outer shell.
They can live only in salty sea water.
They have a spine, or back bone.
They breathe through gills all their lives.

quiz.why_en: A vertebrate is an animal with a spine, or back bone (p.50).

quiz.stem_en: Which pair of body parts does a fish use to breathe and to swim?
quiz.why_en: Fish breathe with gills and push themselves through the water with their fins (p.51).

quiz.stem_en: 'Most whales call out at frequencies of thirty-five hertz and lower, while this lonely whale's sounds are at around fifty-five hertz.' Why can't other whales understand Blue 55?

choices.en: He calls much higher than other whales, in a unique pattern.
He never sings to any other whale.
He swims too deep for sound to travel.
He lost his voice when he was very young.

quiz.why_en: His voice is about 20 hertz higher and his song has a unique pattern (p.53).

quiz.stem_en: Which collective noun goes with whales?
quiz.why_en: Whales swim in a pod; herds are elephants, flocks are birds and prides are lions (p.55).

quiz.stem_en: Complete this sentence about a favourite gadget: 'It's got to be my tablet – I can't ___ without it!'
quiz.why_en: 'I can't live without it' means the gadget is so useful that you always need it (p.63).

quiz.stem_en: Asimo can move by itself using sensors inside its body. What is a sensor?

choices.en: A battery that produces electricity for a robot
A machine that changes something to make it better
A robot that looks and moves like a human
A device that detects objects nearby

quiz.why_en: The Key words box says a sensor is a device that detects objects nearby (p.64).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the correct past simple form: 'Scientists at Honda ___ developing Asimo in the 1980s.'
quiz.why_en: 'In the 1980s' is a finished time in the past, so the verb takes the past simple -ed form (p.65).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the correct form: 'Uber Jet Boots ___ the traffic problems in our city.'
quiz.why_en: After will we use the plain verb, with no 'to' and no ending (p.67).

quiz.stem_en: Which sentence correctly predicts that something will NOT happen in the future?

choices.en: You won't to need travel by car any more.
You don't will need to travel by car any more.
You won't need to travel by car any more.
You will not needing to travel by car any more.

quiz.why_en: The negative is won't (= will not) followed straight away by the plain verb (p.67).

quiz.stem_en: Complete Hassan's sentence: 'We depend on the wheel for all our transport, ___ cars, trains and planes.'
quiz.why_en: 'Such as' introduces examples, and cars, trains and planes are examples of transport (p.68).

quiz.stem_en: Hassan writes: 'You would have to walk, or ride on a horse or camel!' Which reason for the wheel does this support?

choices.en: Without wheels it is hard to travel long distances.
Wheels make the machines in factories work.
Wheels are used for carrying very heavy things.
Wheels inside machines are given the name 'cogs'.

quiz.why_en: Walking or riding an animal is his example of how slow travel would be without wheels (p.68).

quiz.stem_en: Complete with the correct multi-word verb: 'We've built the model car – now we're going to ___ it ___ to see if it works.'
quiz.why_en: 'Try something out' means to test it to see if it works, as Garth did with his Bodybrella (p.73).

quiz.stem_en: Which pair of words BOTH have the short /æ/ sound of the letter 'a'?
quiz.why_en: Strap and bag have the short /æ/ sound, while the other pairs all have the long /eɪ/ sound (p.73).

quiz.stem_en: In the story Todd Barker grabbed the Bodybrella, sneered and said 'It looks dumb!' What does 'sneer' mean?

choices.en: To shout something very loudly at someone
To feel sorry for someone who is sad
To laugh quietly at your own joke
To look at someone in a cruel way

quiz.why_en: The Glossary on that page gives 'sneer: to look at someone in a cruel way' (p.71).

quiz.stem_en: One quiz clue says: 'It was 22 centimetres long and ___ 1.13 kilograms!' Which word tells you how heavy it was?
quiz.why_en: Kilograms are a measure of weight, so the verb is 'weighed' (p.62).

quiz.stem_en: The article says: 'In 2018, Honda stopped producing the robot in its current form.' Which sentence is true?

choices.en: Honda still makes Asimo robots in that form.
Honda no longer makes Asimo in that form.
Honda built the very first Asimo robot in 2018.
Honda sold the Asimo robot to Disneyland in 2018.

quiz.why_en: 'Stopped producing' means Honda no longer makes it, although it still uses Asimo's technology (p.64).

quiz.stem_en: You want to describe an invention without saying its name. Which sentence starter gives a reason why people need it?

choices.en: In my opinion, the best invention ever is…
Today I'm going to talk about my idea for…
People need this invention so they can…
That's true, but I don't really agree with…

quiz.why_en: 'so they can…' introduces the reason people need the invention (p.69).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'You ___ travel as fast as you like on the Uber Jet Boots.'
quiz.why_en: After will you need the plain verb 'be', which gives 'will be able to' (p.67).

quiz.stem_en: The lady told Garth: 'Don't let stupid ignorant boys like that put you down! Keep inventing…' What is she telling him to do?

choices.en: Keep believing in his ideas even when others laugh.
Stop making inventions until he is a grown-up.
Show his broken Bodybrella to the Barker Boys.
Ask the boys to say sorry for breaking his invention.

quiz.why_en: 'Put you down' means make you feel small, so she is telling him to keep believing in himself (p.72).

quiz.stem_en: Complete this comparison: 'I think a mountain bike is ___ useful than an ordinary bike on rough ground.'
quiz.why_en: 'Than' shows you are comparing two things, so the adjective needs 'more … than' (p.63).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'If something is made well, it usually ___ longer.'
quiz.why_en: 'Last' means to continue to be in good condition, so a well-made thing lasts longer (p.79).

quiz.stem_en: Complete with a comparative adverb: 'I can save my pocket money ___ if I don't go shopping!'
quiz.why_en: 'Easily' is an adverb ending in -ly, so its comparative is 'more easily' (p.79).

quiz.stem_en: Which phrase means 'spending money on something that isn't useful'?
quiz.why_en: That is the definition of 'a waste of money' in the vocabulary activity (p.79).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'You can't buy those expensive trainers if you can't ___ them.'
quiz.why_en: 'Afford' means to have enough money to buy something (p.79).

quiz.stem_en: Ava and Alex's ingredients cost $13.00 and their paper bags cost $2.00. They sold 95 brownies at $1.00 each. What was their profit?
quiz.why_en: $95.00 of sales minus $15.00 of total costs leaves a profit of $80.00 (p.80).

quiz.stem_en: Ava and Alex made $80.00 profit, and 50% of it goes to the charity Polar Bear Rescue. How much does that charity get?
quiz.why_en: 50% is the fraction 1/2, and half of $80.00 is $40.00 (p.81).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the correct quantifiers: 'All the profit goes to two charities, ___ Polar Bear Rescue ___ Global Welfare.'
quiz.why_en: 'Either… or…' means one of two things, and there are exactly two charities here (p.81).

quiz.stem_en: Which quantifier means 'lots of', rather than a smaller amount like three or four?
quiz.why_en: 'Plenty of' means lots, while 'several' means a smaller amount, about 3 or 4 (p.81).

quiz.stem_en: Complete this suggestion: 'How about ___ a small amount of the money for new library books?'
quiz.why_en: 'How about' and 'What about' are followed by verb + -ing (p.83).

quiz.stem_en: In the discussion someone says: 'We think it's a good idea to buy sports equipment, but not for the table tennis club.' What are they doing?

choices.en: Encouraging other people to say something
Disagreeing with everything that was said
Agreeing with one part of the idea only

quiz.why_en: The word 'but' shows they accept part of the idea and reject part, which is partly agreeing (p.83).

quiz.stem_en: The class raised $825 by holding a book fair. What does 'raise money' mean here?

choices.en: To collect money by doing an activity
To ask your parents for more pocket money
To put money in a bank so it grows bigger
To make the prices in a shop go up

quiz.why_en: You raise money by doing an activity, such as a book fair or a community event (p.82).

quiz.stem_en: Complete with a reflexive pronoun: 'Last year I saved and bought a video game ___.'
quiz.why_en: The subject is 'I', so the reflexive pronoun has to be 'myself' (p.85).

quiz.stem_en: Complete with a reflexive pronoun: 'Pocket money teaches us to manage money ___.'
quiz.why_en: 'Us' becomes 'ourselves', and plural reflexive pronouns end in -selves (p.85).

quiz.stem_en: Ismail writes: 'However, some parents say that children already have everything they need.' What does 'However' show?

choices.en: That another supporting point is being added
That this is the reason for his opinion
That the points are in order of importance
That a contrasting point is coming next

quiz.why_en: 'However' introduces a point against his own opinion, so it shows a contrast (p.84).

quiz.stem_en: In which of these words from the story does the letter 's' have the hard /z/ sound?
quiz.why_en: A plural -s after a voiced sound such as /m/ is said /z/, so 'problems' ends in /z/ (p.89).

quiz.stem_en: In Billionaire Boy, the Spuds had 'a butler called Otis who was also an orang-utan'. What is a butler?

choices.en: A special glass that you drink from
A type of servant who works in a house
A bathroom attached to a bedroom
A gold tap in an expensive house

quiz.why_en: The Glossary for that page gives 'butler: a type of servant' (p.86).

quiz.stem_en: Joe Spud already had two speedboats and a birthday cheque. When his dad asked what else he wanted, what did Joe say?
quiz.why_en: Joe already had everything money could buy, so the one thing he wanted was a friend (p.87).

quiz.stem_en: Joe told his dad: 'I want to go to a normal school. With normal kids.' Why did he want that?

choices.en: Because he wanted to learn to ski in the morning.
Because his dad would build a school in the garden.
Because he wanted everyone to know he was rich.
Because he hoped he would make a friend there.

quiz.why_en: He had no friends at St Cuthbert's and thought he might make one at the local comp (p.88).

quiz.stem_en: Which of these is a compound noun?
quiz.why_en: A compound noun is two words used as one name, and marine describes biologist (p.95).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'I was always really keen ___ sport at school.'
quiz.why_en: The adjective keen always takes the preposition on (p.95).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'I became more interested ___ coding when I was twelve.'
quiz.why_en: The adjective interested always takes the preposition in (p.95).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'I had to work really hard ___ maths and science.'
quiz.why_en: We work hard at a subject, in the same way that we are good at it (p.95).

quiz.stem_en: Which job means studying the animals and plants that live in the sea?
quiz.why_en: A marine biologist is a scientist whose subject is life in the sea (p.94).

quiz.stem_en: A designer puts waterproof material on the trousers of a uniform, from the ankle to the knee. Which problem does this solve?

choices.en: The person cannot be seen when the light is poor.
The bottom of the trousers gets wet on wet ground.
The person cannot carry money and keys safely.
The uniform does not fit people of all sizes.

quiz.why_en: Waterproof material low down keeps the trousers dry when the ground is wet (p.96).

quiz.stem_en: A uniform for a postman has a belt with pockets for a phone and keys. Why put them on a belt instead of in the jacket?

choices.en: It shows the post office logo on the front right at the top.
It makes the fabric stretchy for people of all shapes and sizes.
It leaves the person's hands free to deliver the post.
It makes the trousers waterproof from the ankle to the knee.

quiz.why_en: The belt carries the small things so that both hands stay free for the post (p.96).

quiz.stem_en: A uniform has a reflective white stripe. What does reflective mean here?

choices.en: It keeps the rain off the shoulders and arms.
It stretches to fit both big and slim people.
It holds an alarm that makes a loud sound.
It shows up when there isn't much light.

quiz.why_en: Reflective means that something shows up in the dark when light hits it (p.97).

quiz.stem_en: Someone says: 'I have done three spacewalks so far.' Complete the report: Karina says that she ___ three spacewalks so far.
quiz.why_en: In reported speech after says that, the third person uses has done (p.99).

quiz.stem_en: Which sentence is correct reported speech?

choices.en: She say to me that she loved her job.
She told me that she loved her job.
She said me that she loved her job.
She told that she loved her job.

quiz.why_en: Tell needs a person after it: she told me that… (p.99).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'Working outside the space station is ___ , so astronauts train for years.'
quiz.why_en: Risky means a little dangerous, which is why the training takes years (p.98).

quiz.stem_en: Which adjective is the opposite of adventurous?
quiz.why_en: This opposite is made with the prefix un-: adventurous → unadventurous (p.99).

quiz.stem_en: Correct the mistake in this advert line: 'We is looking for a talented gardener.'

choices.en: We are looking for a talented gardener.
We am looking for a talented gardener.
We is look for a talented gardener.
We be looking for a talented gardener.

quiz.why_en: The subject we takes are in the present continuous: we are looking (p.101).

quiz.stem_en: Which sentence is written in the shortened style used in job adverts?

choices.en: You are able to do experiments.
Must be able to do experiments.
You must be able to do experiments.
Are you able to do experiments?

quiz.why_en: Adverts drop the pronoun you and start straight at must (p.101).

quiz.stem_en: An advert says: 'Must be very flexible, strong and athletic. Must be able to balance on one leg. Interviews will be held on the tightrope.' Which job is it for?
quiz.why_en: Balancing, being flexible and a tightrope interview all point to an acrobat (p.100).

quiz.stem_en: In the line 'You could be a doctor and look after the sick', what does could mean?

choices.en: You are allowed to be a doctor.
You will definitely be a doctor.
You used to be a doctor long ago.
It is possible that you will be a doctor.

quiz.why_en: Could + be talks about a possible future, not permission and not certainty (p.104).

quiz.stem_en: Which job word ends with the suffix -ist?
quiz.why_en: Scientist takes -ist, while builder and plasterer take -er and actor takes -or (p.104).

quiz.stem_en: Which word has the same vowel sound as day, so that the two words rhyme?
quiz.why_en: Day and way both end in the vowel sound /eɪ/ (p.104).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'We ___ making a film in Indonesia when the volcano suddenly exploded.'
quiz.why_en: The past continuous of we is were + verb-ing (p.113).

quiz.stem_en: Complete with the past continuous: 'Houses ___ as the earth opened up in huge cracks.'
quiz.why_en: Houses is plural, so the past continuous is were + disappearing (p.113).

quiz.stem_en: Which word means the hot melted rock that flows out of a volcano?
quiz.why_en: Lava is the melted rock; ash is the grey powder and the crater is the hole at the top (p.112).

quiz.stem_en: Which sentence uses the past simple and the past continuous correctly together?

choices.en: We are almost a kilometre away when the lava rolled towards us.
We were almost a kilometre away when the lava was rolling towards us.
We was almost a kilometre away while the lava rolls towards us.
We been almost a kilometre away when the lava roll towards us.

quiz.why_en: Both verbs must be in a past form, and were goes with we (p.113).

quiz.stem_en: Inside a storm cloud, what do the tiny ice crystals with a positive charge do?

choices.en: They sink to the bottom of the cloud.
They turn back into warm, humid air.
They rise to the top of the cloud.
They fall to the ground as heavy rain.

quiz.why_en: The tiny crystals have a positive charge and rise; the bigger negative pieces sink (p.114).

quiz.stem_en: What makes the pieces of ice inside a storm cloud bump into each other?

choices.en: the positive charge on the ground

quiz.why_en: The storm winds move the ice pieces around so that they bump together and create a charge (p.114).

quiz.stem_en: There is a negative charge at the bottom of a storm cloud. Why does lightning hit trees and towers instead of flat ground?

choices.en: The positive charge on the ground needs a tall object to connect with the cloud.
The negative charge at the top of the cloud is heavier than ice.
Warm air rising from the ground pushes the spark sideways.
Tall metal objects pull warm, humid air upwards first.

quiz.why_en: The positive charge needs a tall object to connect with the negative charge in the cloud (p.114).

quiz.stem_en: Lightning can set things on fire. It is nearly ___ , hotter than the surface of the sun.
quiz.why_en: Lightning reaches nearly 30,000°C, far hotter than the surface of the sun (p.115).

quiz.stem_en: You are outside in a thunderstorm and there is no building to shelter in. Where is it safest to go?

choices.en: next to a long metal fence
into a car with the windows closed
into the middle of an open field

quiz.why_en: A car is safe shelter; a tree, metal and open ground are all dangerous in a storm (p.115).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: '___ the shaking starts, get down on your hands and knees.'
quiz.why_en: As soon as means immediately after, so you act the moment the shaking begins (p.117).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'Stay inside ___ the shaking stops.'
quiz.why_en: Until means up to that point in time, so you stay inside right up to the moment it stops (p.117).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'Don't move from where you are ___ the earthquake is happening.'
quiz.why_en: While means at the same time as, so you stay still for the whole earthquake (p.117).

quiz.stem_en: Two blocks of moving rock get stuck instead of sliding past each other. What happens when they finally break free?

choices.en: The rocks melt and turn into lava under the fault line.
The fault line closes up and the plates stop moving for ever.
The pressure is released and waves travel under the ground.
The pressure slowly builds up until the plates get stuck again.

quiz.why_en: When the stuck plates break free, the pressure is released and causes waves under the ground (p.116).

quiz.stem_en: Which verb means to move along on your hands and knees?
quiz.why_en: Crawl is the verb of movement for going along on hands and knees (p.117).

quiz.stem_en: In CE79 a volcano in the south of Italy produced an ash cloud that covered the city of Pompeii. How high was that cloud?
quiz.why_en: The eruption produced an ash cloud that was over 20 kilometres high (p.118).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'I was really amazed ___ what I saw at Pompeii.'
quiz.why_en: The adjective amazed takes the preposition by (p.118).

quiz.stem_en: Which word means the time when the sun rises in the morning?
quiz.why_en: Dawn is sunrise; sunset is the opposite, in the evening (p.122).

quiz.stem_en: Which pair of words shares the same vowel sound?
quiz.why_en: Bright and shining both contain the vowel sound /aɪ/ (p.122).

quiz.stem_en: Complete this sentence about a game: 'The graphics are ___!'
quiz.why_en: An -ing participle adjective describes the thing that causes the feeling (p.129).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'My mum was a bit ___ about the video game I was playing.'
quiz.why_en: An -ed participle adjective says how a person feels (p.129).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'It's quite difficult to play and that makes it more ___.'
quiz.why_en: The game causes the feeling, so it takes the -ing adjective (p.129).

quiz.stem_en: Which word means all the music that is used in a film?
quiz.why_en: The soundtrack is the music of a film; the cast is the actors (p.128).

quiz.stem_en: Which word means all the actors who appear in a film?
quiz.why_en: The cast is the group of actors; costumes are the clothes they wear (p.128).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'These early films ___ in black and white.'
quiz.why_en: Films is plural and the time is past, so the passive is were + made (p.131).

quiz.stem_en: Complete: 'In 1891, the first film projector ___ by the Edison company.'
quiz.why_en: One projector and a past year, so the past simple passive is was invented (p.131).
